material.acceptance_criteria: ci.yml gains a job that adds the wasm32-unknown-unknown target and runs cargo check -p web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown and the wasip3 build/tests, with the toolchain version pinned in all workflows.
material.description: /workspace/oscraft/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs cargo nextest --workspace only; rust/Cargo.toml:5 excludes crates/wasip3, so its tests (crates/wasip3/tests/fallback.rs) never run; the wasm32 target is first built in pages.yml/release.yml at deploy, so a wasm-only break (std::time, getrandom, panic=abort paths) surfaces after the push, not in the ci run. dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable is also unpinned in all three workflows.
